Class NativeConfigReader

java.lang.Object
net.phoenix.chromatic_codes.config.NativeConfigReader
public final class NativeConfigReader extends Object
Reads configuration through a temporary Forge parser without rewriting the source file.

The reader bounds file size, checks structural completeness, and appends a private marker to a temporary parse copy. Finding that marker afterward proves the parser reached the end. Only the mapped result escapes; the temporary configuration file is deleted on all exits.

A mapper may fill defaults in the temporary view, but should return detached values rather than retain the parser or its file. Publish application settings after read returns, so parsing, mapping and temporary-file cleanup have all succeeded. Exceptions from the mapper pass through to the caller.

      public static <T> T read(@NotNull Path source, int maxBytes, @NotNull Function<net.minecraftforge.common.config.Configuration, T> map) throws IOException
      Reads with an explicit byte budget, retaining only data returned by the mapper.
      Type Parameters:
      T - detached result type
      Parameters:
      source - existing source path
      maxBytes - positive size limit smaller than Integer.MAX_VALUE
      map - callback returning detached data; it may fill defaults in the temporary view but must not retain the parser or its file
      Returns:
      mapped result
      Throws:
      IOException - if bounded reading, strict parsing or temporary-file handling fails
      IllegalArgumentException - if the byte budget is invalid
      NullPointerException - if a required argument is null
